text:
Ethan Brooks: Hey all — Ethan (Intern, Infra). I can open the 'Intern Onboarding' board in Notion but it's view-only. Our cohort (4 people) wants a shared editable copy to track ramp items. Who owns the canonical board and what's the fastest way to get page-level edit rights for the cohort? Also, who should we tag if we find duplicate/old items to archive?

Lina Morales: Welcome Ethan! Canonical intern templates are under Redwood > People Ops > Interns. The owner is usually the People Ops manager listed on the page properties (check the right-hand panel). Fastest path: request page-level Editor for that specific onboarding page instead of workspace-wide permissions.

devex: To request cohort editors, please send a single message with: 1) full Notion page URL, 2) list of names + work emails, 3) requested duration (e.g., 30 days). We prefer page-level Editors for temporary collaboration. Example request format you can copy/paste: 

```
@devex please add Editor on https://redwood.notion.so/Intern-Onboarding-abc123 for:
- Ethan Brooks (ethan@redwood.com)
- Priya Kumar (priya@redwood.com)
- Jamal Ortiz (jamal@redwood.com)
- Mei Tan (mei@redwood.com)
Duration: 45 days
Reason: cohort ramp notes + team demo schedule
```

docs-bot: Reminder: include the page URL and emails in the request. Requests without emails will be delayed. For permanent access changes open a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk and tag `docs-access`.

Heather Liu: A few practical tips we use for cohorts: (1) Duplicate the canonical board into a Team > Interns > Cohort-Spring2026 folder so the cohort page lives in a shared space. (2) Add a page property called `Visibility` (Private/Team/Cohort) and set to `Cohort`. (3) Create a DB template row called "Week 0 - Onboarding" so everyone has the same starter checklist.

Ethan Brooks: If we duplicate into the Team space, will the database properties (Owner, Status, Due) still be editable by the cohort? I want managers to be able to assign owners.

Lina Morales: Yes — properties copy over. Make sure to update the DB view permissions and invite managers as Editors or Commenters. If you want managers to always set an owner, add an explicit column `Owner` of type Person and add an instruction in the DB template: "Assign Owner before marking complete." We also add a page-level checklist at top with owner placeholders to make it obvious.

devex: One additional note about archive policy (answers your other q): we run an automation that sweeps pages in Team > Interns where `Status` == `Stale` for > 90 days and moves them to People Ops > Archive. To request undeletion or prevent sweep, tag `no-archive` in a page property or ask People Ops to exempt the page. To flag outdated docs, comment on the page and tag the Person owner or ping @Heather Liu (she's part of docs triage).

Ethan Brooks: Awesome, super clear. I'll duplicate the board into Team > Interns > Cohort-Spring2026, add the `Visibility` property, create Week 0 template row, and DM @devex with the URL + emails and Duration: 45 days. One last Q: is there a preferred naming convention for cohort pages so automations pick them up?

Heather Liu: Yes — please use `Intern - <FirstLast> - <CohortSeasonYear>` for individual pages and `Cohort - <SeasonYear>` for cohort boards. Example: `Intern - EthanBrooks - CohortSpring2026` and `Cohort - Spring2026`. That naming pattern is what our archival and reporting scripts look for.

Ethan Brooks: Great — thanks everyone! Will send the request now. :raised_hands:
